scope: Chapter 3 of the Moin scene prototype (src/story/scenes/03.ts): character lines, replays, lock phrases, oral practice and new story phrases with plurals
notes: Whisper writes numbers as digits (50, 55, 100, 20, 90); those takes say the numbers in words as written.
For 'Moin! Die Leiter? Ja … Moment!' two of three takes dropped 'Moin' and the third ended at -30.6 dB; six more seeds were generated and a complete take ending at -39.7 dB was kept.
One take of 'Lotte! Krümel! Psst! Hunde – nein! Nicht im Büro!' was cut off at the end (tails.py); a complete take was chosen.
tails.py passes on all 49 imported files (no fragment after the phrase, no clipped ending).
